title: Exact-derived graph projections satisfy the prescribed base-change rectangle
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:U\to X$ separated etale, $c=(i:U\to Z,p:Z\to X)$ a compactification, and $g:X'\to X$ arbitrary. Put $U'=X'\times_XU$, with projections $h:U'\to U$ and $f':U'\to X'$. Let $c'=(i':U'\to Z',p':Z'\to X')$ be the pulled-back compactification, and $t:Z'\to Z$ its projection. Write $D(V)$ for the whole unbounded derived category of sheaves of $A$-modules on the small etale site of a scheme $V$. Let $E_D=Df_!$, $J_D=Di_!$, $J'_D=Di'_!$, and let $\delta_D:E_DDp^*\to J_D$ and $\delta'_D:Df'_!Dp'^*\to J'_D$ be [lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection]. Write $C_\Sigma:E_DDg^*\simeq Dh^*Df'_!$ for the specified sum exchange, $E_j:Lh^*J'_D\simeq J_DLt^*$ for the specified derived open-extension exchange, $\theta^L:Lg^*Lp'^*\simeq Lp^*Lt^*$ for the total-left-derived square, and $\varphi_u:Lu^*\simeq Du^*$ for the canonical exact comparisons [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison]. For every $K\in D(U)$ one has
$$Lp'^*(C_{\Sigma,K});\varphi_{p',Df'_!(Dh^*K)};\delta'_{D,Dh^*K}=Lp'^*(\varphi^{-1}_{g,E_DK});\theta^L_{E_DK};Lt^*(\varphi_{p,E_DK};\delta_{D,K});E^{-1}_{j,K};J'_D(\varphi_{h,K}).$$
The identity follows by exact-derived descent [lem-a2-exact-derived-natural-transformations] and the termwise identification [lem-a2-compact-support-termwise-projection]; no total derived proper direct image occurs.

proof.text: Apply the exact derived projection-square theorem to the ordinary sheaf graph equation. The termwise-projection formula identifies both graph projections, and the exact square definitions identify the sum and open-extension comparisons. Cancel the open-extension isomorphism to obtain the equation entirely in exact derived inverse images.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] [IsSeparated f]
    (c : Compactification f) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    let c' := c.ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip
    let h := pullback.snd g f
    let t := pullback.fst c.g g
    let E := (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
    let E' := (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst g f)
      inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
    let J' := (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.i).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).mapDerivedCategory
    let P' := (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.g).leftDerivedFunctor
    P'.map ((exactEtaleSumExchange A f g).hom.app K) ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.g).hom.app
          (E'.obj (H.obj K)) ≫
        (compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A (pullback.fst g f) c'
          (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A (pullback.fst g f) c')).app (H.obj K) =
      P'.map ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).inv.app (E.obj K)) ≫
        (derivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g g).toCommSq).hom.app (E.obj K) ≫
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) t).leftDerivedFunctor.map
          ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).hom.app (E.obj K) ≫
            (compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A f c
              (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c)).app K) ≫
        (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (c.isPullback_i_ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip)).inv.app K ≫
        J'.map ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).hom.app K)
